features: Multi-format intake: Docs, Sheets, Canva, CSV, images, text
Rules first, AI fallback for categorization
No separate database — just the vault
Dedupe: update in place, not duplicate
Project name + description typed in at intake
Automatic Inbox processing (no manual "process the inbox" prompt needed)
Working Links per project — quick-reference URLs, never fetched or summarized
Live agent-activity indicator — real status while the vault is being read/written
Ask AI — real Gemini-powered chat, scoped per project, opt-in via a free API key
Ask AI also lives on its own sidebar page — pick any project from a dropdown, ask from anywhere
Dashboard category breakdown as a donut chart; Inbox laid out in two columns to cut scrolling

quickstart.example_input: Google Doc link + project “Q1 Campaign” + description “Client X campaign brief draft”, pasted into Inbox
quickstart.example_output: Note filed: company Client X · project Q1 Campaign · category Campaign Brief · 3 key facts

items.description: Full launch task tracker for 9YM covering game material, marketing, SDK, QA, CS
96-slide game overview and competitor analysis (vs Moonlight Blade, Sword of Shadows) with SWOT
Maps roughly 30 CN-server patches (2015-2019) to a planned TH OBT patch timeline
Optimistic/Realistic/Pessimistic revenue and UA forecast for 9YM, benchmarked against CABAL Mobile's historical actuals
HOF company profile - CEO bio and social reach, vision/mission, headcount, product list, 2026 campaigns
Tales Runner product profile - genre, monetization, competitors, launch history, Aug 2026 performance
WarZ TH product profile, 9-title competitor comparison, daily DAU/CCU/revenue tracking Jun-Aug 2026
Season 1 GTM strategy hub - brand, objectives, audience, positioning, player journey
Team operating guidebook - how to use the strategy, six team playbooks, brief-approval test
Team Playbook Proposal workbook - master KPIs, RACI, execution examples, 11-item open decision log
